text: Vine-Wrapped Farmers are humans located in Stormsong Valley.

Vinyetis (a pun on "vignette" and "yeti") are used as placeholders for vignettes during alpha and beta stages. They most commonly use yeti models, but some also appear as satyrs.

The Village Ward is one of the seven district wards of Revendreth. It encompasses the southeastern area bordering the Ceremony Ward to the north and Forest Ward to the west; it also connects to the Castle Ward through a bridge. A large portion of the Endmire runs through it. The Ward is ruled by the Harvester of Envy, currently The Tithelord.
The Violent Looking Flower Pot teaches you how to summon a Carnivorous Lasher, a lasher companion.

The Violet Mistake is an ooze that can be created using the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It will spawn if the pool is filled primarily with equal amounts of Viscous Oil and Mephitic Goo.

Vindicator Iriska was a Lightforged draenei of the Army of the Light. She was the commander and teacher of Valunei on Argus. Iriska taught her the ways of the Light, how to swing a mace, how to heal the injured, and how to face demons without giving in to fear, becoming a paladin. At one point, Iriska even saved Valunei's life and seemingly became friends, with Valunei even calling her sister. Iriska died at some point, and Valunei felt lost. Years later, Valunei joined Tyr's Guard and went on a mission to activate a Temporal Beacon in the Black Empire of the past. There, the n'raqi Hr'qoth conjured an image of Iriska to deceive Valunei. Her mate Talthis was unable to convince Valunei of the
Viper Sting applies a poisonous sting that drain 4% mana over 8 sec (up to a maximum of 8% of the caster's maximum mana). Only one Sting per hunter can be active on any one target.
A virtual economy is an in-game economy, usually consisting of income streams, marketplaces, and gold sinks.
Viznik Goldgrubber is a goblin banker who works at Stranglethorn Trust Bank located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Viscidus is an optional boss in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, a giant slime that can be accessed after the death of Fankriss the Unyielding. This boss requires a high Nature Resistance as it uses AoE poison bolts which have direct damage along with DoTs. He resets if taken outside his room, much like the bosses in Zul'Gurub. If you are about to wipe, run outside the room and you may be able to save your life.
The Voice Amplification Modulator can make even the quietest voice be heard. Just don't put two of them close together or the feedback will be horrible.

.]] Vipore's Gryphon is a gryphon found in Alterac Valley. If successfully summoned by its master, Wing Commander Vipore, it hovers over the lower part of Frostwolf Village and bombards members of the Horde from above. The summoning quest is Call of Air - Vipore's Fleet.
Vizzklick is a goblin tailoring vendor located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.

:"I got what you need." Vixton Pinchwhistle is a goblin PvP rewards vendor. Once located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm, he has now moved back to Azeroth to Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He sells Season 4, Season 8 and Season 11 armor. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
__NOTOC__ Vodesiin is a draenei reagent vendor located at Temple of Telhamat in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Vivid Chrysoprase is an gem that fits a yellow or blue socket.

Vipers are a type of snake. These creatures range widely in size. They are not particularly aggressive, but often lash out with a bite attack before attempting to retreat. Vipers rely on their venomous bite to kill prey and defend themselves. A viper has a poisonous bite that deals initial and secondary damage. Some druids choose large or huge vipers as their animal companion.
__NOTOC__ Violet Tragan is a mushroom that supposedly makes anything taste great, if properly cooked. However, if eaten raw you'll be poisoned.
__NOTOC__ Virtue Bearer's Vambraces drop from Broggok in the Blood Furnace on Heroic mode.

Once you have acquired the messenger's information in the prerequisite quest, The Red Messenger, Executor Arren wants you to take it to his superior in Brill. This quest signals the end to your activities in Deathknell.
The Vision Guide guides your soul to the resting place of the final Thunderlord artifact.
Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet sends the adventurer to Kargath to seek out a shadowmage.
Vision of the Forgotten appear during the quest A Visit With The Ancestors when you visit the four locations, in Nagrand and Terokkar Forest.

Visit the Throne of the Elements is part of the Shattrath Children's Week quest chain for the Horde. All three of Hch'uu and the Mushroom People, A Trip to the Dark Portal (Horde) and Visit the Throne of the Elements must be completed before the next pair of quests is offered.

Vlac is an orc shaman with knowledge of demonic spells in Eredun. He is a companion of Trant.
The Virtuoso Inking Set is a tool used in many inscription recipes. It can be purchased for from inscription and trade supply vendors throughout the world.

The tactic is to tank him until he dismounts. One of the party members can then take his mammoth mount to use it against him.

__NOTOC__ Violetta is a human warlock who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).

The Vir'aani can be found around Oshu'gun in Nagrand. They're a band of rogue ethereals led by the dangerous criminal Gava'xi and have begun to dislodge large fragments from the crystal. Cryo-Engineer Sha'heen has a self buff called [http://www.wowhead.com/spell=33839 Vir'aani Concentration] so they seem to have some kind of relation.
Vir'aani Raiders are ethereals found in the Spirit Fields in Nagrand.
The Vir'naal River is a river that flows through central Uldum. It starts from the Vir'naal Dam and ends at the sea.
Vir'Naal Delta Map drops from Neferset Guards at the Gate of Hamatep in Uldum.

__NOTOC__ Vish the Sneak was a goblin rogue trainer found in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. He is not present after the Goblin Slums became the Orgrimmar Embassy. He can be found sneaking about at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. He will pace back and forth between the Alliance and Horde parts of the camp. As he reaches the middle, he will look both ways before going into stealth, sneaking onwards and stealing some resources back to his own side.

Vizna Bangwrench is a goblin located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. She used to be an engineering supplies vendor at Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar and then at Engineering Works after the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy. She gets replaced by Thaluriel once the player has unlocked allied races. Despite still being titled a vendor, she no longer sells anything.
Vizier's Scrawled Streamer is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Nerubian Archaeology Fragments to complete. Up to two keystones may be used to complete this artifact.
Vitreous Beak of Julak-Doom drops from Julak-Doom in the Twilight Highlands.

Vir'naal Oasis is the name for many locations, mostly around the Vir'naal River, throughout Uldum. These tropical locations are home to many crocolisks and wasps. At the northern most part is where the source of the river begins as water rises from far below, it's here the Scalemother Hevna resides laying eggs that flow down the river and come to rest in the Vir'naal Lake to further the river's corruption.
Visions of Vashj'ir Past is a quest achievement earned for completing the Naz'jar Battlemaiden quests in Vashj'ir, culminating in Final Judgment.
Visitors is a level 39 bread crumb quest that navigates the players to the start of the zone's questlines.

The virmen are a race of primitive rabbit-like people that live in Pandaria akin to kobolds. Commonly seen as little more than aggressive pests, they are obsessed with vegetables, mostly carrots, though they have little love for turnips.
Vishanka, Jaws of the Earth drops from Madness of Deathwing in Dragon Soul.
Vision of Charlga is a vision of Charlga Razorflank appearing after completing Echoes of Agamaggan at Firestone Point in the Southern Barrens.
The Virmen Grotto is a small area east of the Rows on the Wandering Isle. It's here the virmen gather and stockpile the Pilfered Pumpkins. One of the entrances into the Teeming Burrow is found here.

The Virmen Nest can be found just north of the Yan-Zhe River bordering the Thunderfoot Fields in eastern Valley of the Four Winds. The Snagtooth virmen have stolen turnips from Ang Thunderfoot at the Thunderfoot Farm and stashed them in the nest, where they have begun assaulting them.
Virgil is a house cat located at Ella's farm in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Visage of the First Wakener is the hidden artifact appearance for demonology warlocks. To obtain the hidden appearance, you must first be at Artifact Knowledge Rank 4 or higher. You then need to farm eredar mobs in the Broken Isles or Argus for these heads, which will always drop in the following order: Damaged Eredar Head, Deformed Eredar Head, Malformed Eredar Head, Deficient Eredar Head, and Nearly Satisfactory Eredar Head. Visage of the First Wakener will then have a chance to drop after you've looted the previous five heads.

Malus, having already had a certain history with the compass, and the Hidden, are looking for it as well. It is pointing to crystal shards across the world.

Viq'Goth is a kraken first encountered at Anglepoint Wharf, where Director Deepwarden and his followers summoned it in order to attack the seagate. With the help of the Outriggers, an Alliance adventurer managed to repel Viq'Goth back into the sea before it could cause any significant damage to the gate. The Vision of Ronaku is a projection of Lookout Ronaku that appears at the south end of the eastern dock in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun during The Day the Port Fell, holding off a group of Zandalari refugees seeking passage on Pirate-King Zem'lan's ships.

The Vision of Sezza is a projection of Lookout Sezza that appears at the Cursed Altar of Zem'lan on the Golden Isle in Vol'dun during The First Time I Died, as one of the pirates who gathered to witness the ritual in which Pirate-King Zem'lan cursed his crew into skeletons.

The Vision of Bos'n Sno is a projection of Bos'n Sno that appears at the Cursed Altar of Zem'lan on the Golden Isle in Vol'dun during The First Time I Died, as one of the pirates who gathered to witness the ritual in which Pirate-King Zem'lan cursed his crew into skeletons.

The Vision of Ugly Zul is a projection of Ugly Zul that appears at the Cursed Altar of Zem'lan on the Golden Isle in Vol'dun during The First Time I Died, as one of the pirates who gathered to witness the ritual in which Pirate-King Zem'lan cursed his crew into skeletons. The Virtual Ticket gives a front row seat at BlizzCon from the comfort of ones own couch, live and in high definition. They'll get comprehensive coverage of both days of the show, including panels, contests, interviews, the closing ceremony, and more, along with some cool commemorative in-game goodies. They can even stream the convention using the free BlizzCon Mobile app. There was no Virtual Ticket for the 2021 BlizzConline as it was free to watch, although the Celebration Collection was made available in its place that provided in-game goodies. With BlizzCon 2023, the convention will be free to watch while the Virtual Ticket will be an optional purchase. It was further announced on Septem

The Vision of Orgrimmar is a constructed realm that is accessed through the Tenebrous Gateway found in the Chamber of Heart. The Orgrimmar shown in here, is not that of the waking world, but the dangers are as real as can be. Once unlocked, a series of altars can be activated to change the experience. The vision can be evacuated via the Expedition Gateway. One Vessel of Horrific Visions is needed per expedition into the vision. Due to the twisted nature of this realm, the sanity of adventurers who brave its dangers is constantly drained. "Visage Day" is a short story by Steve Danuser first published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. Since September 20, 2022, it is also available for free on the official site. Illustrated by Lindsey Burcar, the story focuses on the bronze dragon Chronormu's preparations and indecision for the titular Visage Day, a ceremony in which dragons decide what their mortal form will be.
